title: Extract shared risk scoring module from pr_risk and review
description: pr_risk.rs and review.rs implement overlapping risk-scoring logic with divergent weights, separate ChurnMap types, and shared magic-number thresholds (50, 30, 20) with no common definition.\n\nExtract risk.rs or scoring.rs: normalization thresholds, Signal enum, RiskModel with configurable weights, gather_file_stats(). Both tools become thin callers. Single ChurnMap definition.

acceptance_criteria.text: Shared risk scoring module exists with configurable weights
pr_risk and review both use the shared module
No duplicated ChurnMap or normalization constants
